title: Learned marker selection precedes mixed macrophage expression checks
summary: LASSO-based selection and network prioritization nominated five periodontitis-associated candidates. A source-reported macrophage comparison found ATF3 and CXCR4 higher, and TXN, CBX3 and MBP lower, at RNA and protein levels. This record represents those expression observations, without adopting a clinical diagnostic test or a causal disease mechanism.

source_review.scope: Actual relevant primary computational/clinical Methods and high-level Results read; no operational biological protocols inspected

evidence.ai_role: LASSO selects22 expression candidates, followed by protein-network prioritization of five that undergo a new expression check. AI credit is limited to nomination, not downstream causal interpretation.
evidence.tested: Actual computational selection sections and nonactionable expression Results were read. The source reports concordant RNA/protein directions in an inflammatory macrophage comparison.
evidence.unknown: Operational culture/assay protocols and supplementary replicate details were not inspected. Archived discovery and validation arrays contain repeated gingival sites per patient, with healthy sites within periodontitis patients and possible cohort overlap; another series includes peri-implantitis and a further RNA-sequencing series includes gingivitis. Clinical discrimination, independent patient validation, novel macrophage taxonomy and therapeutic/causal claims are outside the represented result. The reported model C-index is not adopted as an AUC.
